name: Genki I & II
comment: My backbone for structured grammar. I do the exercises by hand, not just read them — the writing is where it sticks.

name: Tae Kim's Guide to Japanese
comment: Free and blunt about how the language actually works. I use it as a second angle whenever Genki's explanation doesn't click.

name: NHK News Web Easy
comment: Real news rewritten with furigana. Humbling, but it's honest reading practice with sentences I didn't make up.

name: WaniKani
comment: Radicals → kanji → vocab with spaced repetition. I keep reviews small and daily so they never pile into a wall.

name: JLPT Official Practice Workbook
comment: The official sample questions from jlpt.jp. The only source I fully trust for what the real test feels like.

name: Jisho.org
comment: My everyday dictionary. It surfaces JMdict definitions and KANJIDIC2 readings, which is exactly what I want this site to mirror.
